parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, inclusive: ISO 8601 with a time and a zone. Defaults to `to` minus 15 minutes. `to − from` is at most 1 hour (720 buckets of 5 seconds).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range, exclusive: ISO 8601 with a time and a zone. Defaults to now. A time in the future is valid and returns what exists.

400.description: Malformed asset code, a `from` or `to` that is not ISO 8601 with a zone, `to` before `from`, or a range over 1 hour (720 buckets)

get.summary:

info.title: Ops Command Center API
info.description: Incidents, zones, the site plan, cameras and assets. Live updates on the `/events` Socket.IO namespace and telemetry readings on `/telemetry`. Every endpoint needs an OIDC access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; `/events` and `/telemetry` take the same token in the handshake as `auth.token`. Writes need the `operator`, `supervisor` or `technician` role; a `technician` acknowledges and resolves only Facilities and Environment incidents. A token with none of `operator`, `supervisor`, `technician` and `viewer` gets 403.

message.description: What went wrong. Validation failures list every problem as an array.

kind.description:
What kind of area this is: a `building`, `parking` lot, campus `gate`, `outdoor` space,
`sports` ground, `utility` area or `water`.

use.description:
What a building is used for (ADR-0021). `null` for every other kind, and for a building whose
use is not set. Drives report-form suggestions only; restricts nothing.

heightM.description:
Metres above ground of a building's 3D shell (> 0). `null` when not set: clients draw their
default.

center.description: Centre as [lng, lat]. Used as the position of incidents reported without one.

coordinates.description: Closed rings of [lng, lat] points, outer ring first

part.description: What this feature draws: the site `boundary`, a `road`, or a sports-`field` marking.

center.description: Centre of the site as [lng, lat]: where a map opens

features.description: Drawn under the zones, in drawing order. Building footprints and parking rows are not here: clients derive them from the zones.

seed.description: Seed for the synthetic feed. A camera always gets the same seed, so its scene is stable.

heading.description: Centre line of the view, in degrees clockwise from true north (0 ≤ heading < 360)

angle.description: Width of the view, in degrees (0 < angle ≤ 360)

range.description: How far the camera sees, in metres (> 0)

zoneId.description: Zone the camera is mounted in.

online.description: Whether the camera is currently online.

fieldOfView.description: `null` when the orientation is not known; clients then draw no view

modelUrl.description: `/models/<model_key>` of the class's 3D model file. `null` when the class has no model: clients then draw a neutral box from `footprintM`.

footprintM.description: The box a neutral placeholder is drawn from

key.description: camelCase and unique within the asset class

unit.description: `null` for a point with no unit (a boolean or an enum)

min.description: Lowest valid value of a `number` point. `null` when there is no lower bound, and for booleans and enums. A reading outside `min`/`max` is dropped, never clamped.

max.description: Highest valid value of a `number` point. `null` when there is no upper bound, and as `min`.

enumValues.description: The values an `enum` point can take. `null` for every other kind.

expectedIntervalS.description: How often a device sends this point, in seconds (> 0). A client judges freshness against it.

headline.description: Rank among the class's headline points. `null` when the point is not a headline, so it appears in neither the tooltip nor the Assets list.

elevationM.description: Metres of the asset's base above ground (≥ 0). A roof is the building's height.

headingDeg.description: Degrees clockwise from true north (0 ≤ heading < 360); for a model, the direction its front faces

headline.description: The class's headline points, ordered by `headline` rank: at most two

key.description: The `key` of one of the asset's points

comparator.description: Which side of `limit` is a breach

limit.description: The reading that is a breach once passed. A boolean point uses 0.5.

clear.description: The level a reading must pass back before the rule can raise again, on the safe side of `limit`: `clear` ≤ `limit` for `above`, `clear` ≥ `limit` for `below`

forS.description: Seconds a breach must last before it raises an incident (≥ 0)

incidentType.description: A `facilities` or `environment` type of the incident a sustained breach raises

elevationM.description: Metres of the asset's base above ground (≥ 0). A roof is the building's height.

headingDeg.description: Degrees clockwise from true north (0 ≤ heading < 360); for a model, the direction its front faces

headline.description: The class's headline points, ordered by `headline` rank: at most two

points.description: Every point of the class, headline or not: the headline points by rank, then the rest by `key`

rules.description: The enabled rules that apply to this asset, by `name`. An asset-level rule replaces the class rule of the same `name`; a disabled rule is left out, so a disabled asset-level rule turns that rule off for this asset only.

assetCode.description: The asset's tag, as in the path

from.description: Start of the range served, inclusive: the request with its defaults applied.

to.description: End of the range served, exclusive: the request with its defaults applied.

bucketS.description: Width of one bucket, in seconds

samples.description: In ascending time. Empty, not an error, for an asset with no readings in the range and for a range outside the kept days.

at.description: Start of the 5 second bucket, UTC: the API's clock when it received the reading, not the device's measurement time.

values.description: The last value of each point key received in the bucket, by `key`. A key with no reading in the bucket is absent: it is not `null` and it is not zero.

status.description: `open`: not picked up yet. `acknowledged`: an operator is handling it. `resolved`: closed.

position.description: Location as [lng, lat]. The zone centre when none was given at report time.

source.description:
`operator`: reported by a person. `simulator`: generated by the demo incident simulator.
`telemetry`: raised by a telemetry rule.

assetId.description:
The asset whose telemetry rule raised the incident. `null` for `operator` and `simulator`
incidents.

acknowledgedAt.description: When an operator acknowledged it. `null` until then.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved. `null` until then.

version.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change. Keep a cached copy unless this is higher.

kind.description: `user`: a signed-in person. `system`: the API itself (simulator, demo seed, older entries).

subject.description:
The identity provider's subject for a user; `simulator`, `seed`, `telemetry` or `system`
otherwise.

displayName.description: Name to show, as it was when the entry was written.

kind.description: The state change this entry records: `reported`, `acknowledged` or `resolved`.

status.description: `open`: not picked up yet. `acknowledged`: an operator is handling it. `resolved`: closed.

position.description: Location as [lng, lat]. The zone centre when none was given at report time.

`telemetry`: raised by a telemetry rule.

incidents.

acknowledgedAt.description: When an operator acknowledged it. `null` until then.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved. `null` until then.

[lng, lat], longitude -180..180 and latitude -90..90, inside the zone's polygon or on its edge.
Defaults to the zone centre.

severity.description: How urgent it is. Higher severities sort first in the incident list.

note.description: Optional operator note recorded on the timeline.
